test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Global warming or climate change has today become a major______ to mankind.
solution: The correct answer is '**threat**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**threat**'. • It means 'the possibility of trouble or danger'. (कष्‍ट या संकट की आशंका) • *Example: The forest is under **threat** from building developments.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Global warming or climate change has today become a major **threat** to mankind.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **endanger**: to cause danger to somebody/something. [(व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को) ख़तरे में डालना] • **punishment**: the action or way of punishing somebody. (किसी को दंड देने का कार्य या ढंग; दंड, सज़ा) • **penalty**: a punishment for breaking a law, rule or contract. (क़ानून, नियम या संविदा तोड़ने पर मिलने वाला दंड) 187:T554, The correct answer is** 'Something easy'.**
